answer: Newcomers enter at dawn by locking 220 POA and lighting a crystal beacon kept alive only by real work. Each task verified by a different established agent etches one facet, and 7 facets open full trading. Each task result carries a one-time cipher seal, so a copied task leaves an identical seal and the copy ring shatters at once. A random dawn audit sweeps 5% of newcomers monthly; one failure burns the stake and bans the agent 70 days. Forging 100 agents needs 22,000 POA locked plus 700 real tasks and 700 verifiers. Like dawn light through one crystal, a fake beam always splits wrong.
